pricing.title: Artist Sessions
pricing.body:
Editorial photo and video sessions for artists, releases and creative projects.

We are artists working for artists.

Our sessions are built around art direction, storytelling and real collaboration — which means they often go further than a standard photo shoot.

Most independent artist productions fall between €400 and €700, depending on concept, location and what you need the session for.

If you are working on something smaller, or building something meaningful with a limited budget, we are always happy to talk.
